lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, I am calling from the customs office at Mumbai airport.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: A parcel from London has come for you with gold and foreign currency. It was sent by your friend.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Because it was not declared, it is an offence under customs act. You can be arrested for smuggling.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: To avoid the case you have to pay customs clearance charge of 45,000 rupees today itself.
